samples.question: A vertical timeline of four panels reads top to bottom. Each panel shows the same four slots (slot 1 and slot 2 are the LEFT half; slot 3 and slot 4 are the RIGHT half) and each slot holds one token. Every token has a fixed, unique color that never changes as it moves between panels. A magenta ring in the first (top) panel marks the token you must track. Reading the panels top to bottom and following that token's color across every panel, count how many of the four panels have the tracked token sitting in the LEFT half (slot 1 or slot 2). Answer with the count: '0', '1', '2', '3', or '4'.
